run.binary_rule: dedicated outcome judgment per call (temperature 0, JSON, evidence-cited); label in {success,fail}; same question the blind annotator answered. NOT derived from the 5 semantic dims; kappa calibrates THIS judgment only — the semantic dims remain uncalibrated diagnostics.
run.note: uncalibrated — live calls have no human gold labels; no kappa is computed for this slice. Semantic dims are evidence-cited diagnostics only.

dims.name: language_match
dims.reason: The agent consistently uses Hinglish, mirroring the user's code-switching pattern throughout the conversation to ensure clear communication.

dims.name: faithfulness
dims.reason: The agent accurately captured and repeated all user-provided information including name, phone number, tests, date, and time without any hallucinations.

dims.name: repair_quality
dims.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user's initial phone number input was incomplete and asked a targeted follow-up to obtain the remaining digits.

dims.name: conciseness
dims.reason: The agent is generally efficient, but turn 6 is unnecessarily wordy and confusing when asking for phone number confirmation.

dims.name: user_frustration
dims.reason: The user remained cooperative and calm throughout the interaction, successfully providing all necessary details without any signs of irritation or repair loops.

binary.label: success
binary.reason: The agent successfully collected all necessary information for the home sample collection request and informed the user that the clinic staff would follow up to finalize the appointment.
binary.rule: dedicated outcome judgment per call (temperature 0, JSON, evidence-cited); label in {success,fail}; same question the blind annotator answered. NOT derived from the 5 semantic dims; kappa calibrates THIS judgment only — the semantic dims remain uncalibrated diagnostics.
